name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The second clause uses RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box) which only requires the box to be held at some point before or after reaching the exit. The task explicitly says the agent must have the box in its hands when it reaches the exit, i.e., at the same step. Use a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) (or an equivalent formulation that forces holding_box at the moment of at_exit) instead of RespondedExistence.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The candidate lacks a hard goal requiring the agent to reach the exit. The task states that reaching the exit is required (and then the box must be held), but only a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) is present, which is a rule and does not create a goal. Add a hard Existence(at_exit) clause (or equivalent hard goal) so the machine has a final state and the exit is enforced.

texts: If the box falls, the very next step must pick it up (holding_box becomes true)
When the agent reaches the exit, the box must be in the agent's hands
The agent must eventually reach the exit
